summary:
I reject FP-0014 because of one major defect. The tokenizer (Syntax 4), the parser (Syntax 5, including the integrator's 5.5.5 correction in `finishBlock`), selectors, the registry, value grammars, the cascade and rollback, `var()` substitution with cycles and the 65536 limit, and the DOM attribute lists all match the pinned sources and the contract on the paths I checked. All 48 cases exist: cases 1–17 and 21–48 in `src/css/tests.zig`, and cases 18–20 in `src/dom.zig`. Integration evidence at `ef8ad1c` shows 272/272 Zig tests and 192/192 controller tests, with HEAD and a clean status recorded before and after the gates. The mutation control failed only case 35. The named-color check passed 148/148.

The major defect is in `StyleMap.textStyle`. It returns the parent element's whole computed style, but the contract and Cascade 5 §1.1 require a text node's values to come from defaulting: inherited properties inherit, and non-inherited properties take their initial values. As a result, text gets the parent's `display` and margins. Case 34 cannot catch this because its parent `div` already has initial values for those properties.

I also list minor documentation, evidence-binding, algorithmic-complexity, and scope findings. As you asked, I also list where the frozen subset reports a standard form as invalid instead of unsupported, or the reverse.

I ran no shell, git, build, or test commands. Every result I cite comes from the committed logs and receipts.

criteria.criterion: Plan criterion 1: Parse a frozen property and selector set with standard recovery.
criteria.evidence: `parser.zig` follows Syntax 5.5.1–5.5.11. `finishBlock` (parser.zig, "The FP-0014 decision") appends a nonempty `decls` at `}` or EOF, which corrects the pinned 5.5.5 text (css-syntax-3/Overview.bs lines 2846–2930 return only `rules`). Recovery follows mark/restore in `stepBlock`, plus `consumeBadDeclarationRemnants`. Selector grammar matches Selectors 4 §16 (selectors-4/Overview.bs lines 4487–4525). Cases 1–17, 21–24, 29–33, and 36 exist and are counted in integration-tests.log (227+45 tests passed at `ef8ad1c`).

criteria.criterion: Plan criterion 2: Keep selectors, cascade, and computed values separate.
criteria.evidence: `style.resolve` runs `matchRulesWith`, then `cascade.cascade`, then `compute.computeStyle`. `computeStyle` takes only the cascade result, the parent and root styles, `is_root`, the allocators, and the diagnostics list. Case 47 (tests.zig) checks parameter types and the fields of `ApplicableDeclaration` at compile time, and it runs `cascade` and `computeStyle` without a DOM.

criteria.criterion: Plan criterion 3: Describe inheritance and invalidation in the property registry.
criteria.evidence: `properties.zig` holds data-only records with exactly the fields `name`, `spec`, `initial`, `inherited`, `computed`, and `invalidation`. `registry.validate` runs at comptime (registry.zig comptime block). `custom_family` matches the contract table. `ComputedStyle.diff` adds `descendants` for inherited properties. Cases 25–28 cover these.

criteria.criterion: Plan criterion 4: Exercise custom-property token preservation and malformed syntax.
criteria.evidence: Case 14 and case 39 (including the amendment 1 dump) cover original text and token preservation. Case 44 covers malformed values, case 42 cycles, case 45 the 65536 limit, case 46 100000-deep nesting, and case 40 spread and fallbacks.

criteria.criterion: Tokenizer matches Syntax section 4 at the pinned commit.
criteria.evidence: The non-ASCII ident ranges, escape handling (4.3.7), URL and bad-URL handling (4.3.6, 4.3.15), number parsing (4.3.13) with `floatMax` saturation, and unicode-range (4.3.14) all match the pinned text. Cases 1–6 cover them.

criteria.criterion: The 48 exact cases are present and pass at ef8ad1c.
criteria.evidence: Cases 18–20 are at dom.zig:2072, 2120, and 2164. The other cases are in tests.zig. integration-tests.log reports `Build Summary: 65/65 steps succeeded; 272/272 tests passed` (cwd C:\src\fairpane), run between the two HEAD=ef8ad1c records in integration-binding.log. Case 34 passes but cannot detect the textStyle defect.

criteria.criterion: Style resolution, including textStyle defaulting from the parent element (Cascade 1.1).
criteria.evidence: style.zig:55-58 returns `map.get(parent)`, the parent element's full style, so non-inherited properties are not reset to their initial values. Cascade 5 lines 108–112 say text nodes get all of their computed values by defaulting.

The parser uses a `Frame` stack and an `open` list. Selectors use a `Matcher.stack`. Resolution uses an explicit element stack in `style.resolve`. Substitution is a resumable `Substitution` driven by `Engine.drive`. `dump` uses `writeTasks` and `ends`. I found no self-calling or mutually recursive runtime function.

criteria.criterion: Allocation-failure safety: case 20 for DOM attributes and case 48 for parse and resolve.
criteria.evidence: `setAttribute` (dom.zig:316) copies strings and reserves capacity before mutating, with errdefers. Case 20 uses `guarded`, a deep fingerprint, and `checkAllAllocationFailures` with remap failure. Case 48 checks a store digest and `checkAllAllocationFailures` over `Stylesheet.parse` (every diagnostic kind, asserted with an EnumSet) and `resolve`.

mutation-cascade-origin.diff swaps `.user` and `.author` in the important branch of `originPrecedence`. The log shows `193 pass, 1 fail`, and the only failure is 'FP-0014 case 35', `expected 5, found 4`. The sha256 of cascade.zig is c98a9521… before and after. This ran in the worker tree, not at ef8ad1c.

criteria.criterion: Evidence is bound to ef8ad1c, and the named-color check passed.
criteria.evidence: integration-binding.log records HEAD ef8ad1c7… and an empty `status --ignored` before the gates (11:43:15) and after them (11:49:51). All four gate receipts show source fingerprint cce74226… unchanged and status pass. named-colors-check.log records HEAD ef8ad1c, a spec sha256 of 5b0be760…, `specification rows: 148`, `named_colors.zig rows: 148`, and `result: pass`. I confirmed that the script's regex matches the table rows at css-color-4/Overview.bs:1621 and following.

findings.issue: `textStyle` returns the parent element's entire `ComputedStyle`. The contract says it returns a text node's style 'by defaulting from its parent element (Cascade 1.1)'. Cascade 5 (lines 108–112 at the pin) says text nodes get all of their computed values by defaulting, so non-inherited properties must take their initial values. Minimal repro: a document with root `r` and a text child of `r`, plus the sheet `r { display: block; margin-top: 5px }`. `textStyle(text)` returns `display` block flow and `margin_top` 5px, but the expected values are inline flow and 0px. Case 34 (tests.zig:1072) cannot detect this because its parent `div` already has initial values for `display` and margins.
findings.recommendation: Build the text style from the parent's inherited properties (`color`, `font-size`, custom properties) and the initial values of non-inherited properties (`display` inline flow with no root blockification, all margins 0px). Add a case where the parent has non-initial `display` and margins.

findings.issue: The module doc (line 8) and the evidence README (line 86) claim that rules and declarations inside an at-rule's block are dropped with the at-rule 'without their own diagnostics'. That is false. `qualifiedPrelude` returns true in `at_rule_block` (line 137), and the nested style rule's block runs in `qualified_rule_block`, where `declaration` diagnoses (line 187). Repro: `@media x { b { colour: red } }` reports `unknown_property` (colour) before `ignored_at_rule` (media). `@media x { a { b {} } }` reports `nested_rule_ignored`. `@media a { @media b {} }` reports two `ignored_at_rule` diagnostics.
findings.recommendation: Correct the module doc and the README. Alternatively, suppress validation inside at-rule blocks, for example by propagating `silent`. Add a case for either behavior.

findings.issue: At the pin, Values 5 also defines if(), inherit(), attr(), ident(), and random-item() as arbitrary substitution functions (css-values-5 lines 1671, 1901, 2184, 2347, 2728). Only `var()` is recognized. In a custom property, these functions are neither substituted nor reported, so `--x: attr(data-x)` computes to raw `function(attr)` tokens with no diagnostic. A spread inside them is not reported either: `--s: if(...var(--args); else: x)` substitutes the inner `var()` and keeps the dots. The contract says a value that 'uses the spread syntax inside an arbitrary substitution function' becomes invalid with `unsupported_value`. Standard properties are unaffected, because `parseStandard` reports `unsupported_value` for these functions.
findings.recommendation: Treat any non-var arbitrary substitution function in a custom property value as invalid at computed-value time with `unsupported_value`, including when it holds a spread. Otherwise, add this explicitly to the FP-0071 obligations in css.zig and the README.

findings.issue: These standard forms are reported as `invalid_value` instead of `unsupported_value`. (1) `display: grid-lanes` and `display: inline-grid-lanes`, which css-grid-3 defines at the pinned commit (Overview.bs line 346, 'New values: grid-lanes | inline-grid-lanes'). This contradicts the integrator decision that 'Every standard form outside that subset produces the diagnostic unsupported_value'. (2) `display: math`, `block math`, and `inline math` (MathML Core). (3) The column combinator `a||b`, which Selectors 4 moved to Selectors 5 (selectors-4 line 5163). Case 22 (tests.zig:495) freezes it as `invalid_selector`. (4) Every standard property outside the registry (for example `margin` or `background-color`) gets `unknown_property`, the same diagnostic as a typo such as `colour`. Items 2–4 follow the contract text.
findings.recommendation: Add `grid-lanes` and `inline-grid-lanes`, and the MathML `math` inner type, to the unsupported display keywords, or record a contract erratum. Record the column combinator and the conflation of non-registry properties with unknown names as FP-0070 and FP-0071 obligations.

findings.issue: These cases are the reverse: invalid or non-standard values reported as `unsupported_value` or `unsupported_selector`. `parseStandard` returns unsupported for any function other than var, rgb, and rgba anywhere in the value. That includes non-standard functions (`color: foo(1)`) and values that are invalid anyway (`margin-top: calc(1px) 2px`, `color: red hsl(0 0% 0%)`). `parseDisplay` (line 430) returns unsupported before structure checks, so `display: flex list-item`, `flex flex`, and `foo grid` are unsupported. `parseRgb` (lines 576 and 584) treats any function argument, or `from` with arbitrary trailing content, as unsupported. Selectors report every `:ident`, `::ident`, and function pseudo as unsupported, including nonexistent ones such as `:nonsense`, and every `ns|E` even though an undeclared prefix is invalid per Namespaces. All of this is contract-mandated.
findings.recommendation: Record these over-approximations for FP-0070 and FP-0071, so that those tasks classify invalid and unsupported forms precisely.

findings.issue: Descendant and subsequent-sibling matching backtracks over every candidate with no failure memoization or early exit, so the worst case is O(N^k) for k such combinators on depth or sibling count N. Example: the selector `x e e e` (no `x` element) against case 46's 100000-deep chain of `e` elements tries on the order of C(100000,3) paths per element. Hostile web content could hang style resolution. `ClassIterator.occursBefore` (dom.zig:815) also makes class lookup O(n²) in the number of class tokens.
findings.recommendation: Add the standard early exit: when a descendant combinator's left side fails for every ancestor, stop trying higher ancestors for compounds to its right (Servo's NotMatchedGlobally, or Blink's equivalent). Match classes without the O(n²) dedupe scan.

findings.issue: Line 46 says '`node tools/fairpane.mjs check` passes on the final tree', but no raw log records that run on the worker tree; only the integration gate at ef8ad1c exists. tests-after.log, fmt.log, controller-tests-after.log, and the mutation logs ran in C:\Users\requi\.omp\wt\tb5fa5c781\m before integration. The mutation's cascade.zig digest (c98a9521…) is never shown to equal ef8ad1c's src/css/cascade.zig.
findings.recommendation: Cite the ef8ad1c repo-check receipt for that claim, or record the worker-tree run. Record `sha256sum src/css/cascade.zig` at ef8ad1c, or rerun the mutation control there, to bind it to the integrated commit.

findings.issue: The palette contrast test omits the ButtonBorder border pairing that Color 4 §6.2 lists among the 'system color pairings' (pinned css-color-4 lines 2065–2075). By my calculation, ButtonBorder (118 118 118) against the adjacent Canvas has a ratio of about 4.54:1, so the palette passes. The test still does not assert it.
findings.recommendation: Add the Canvas–ButtonBorder pair to the contrast test.

findings.issue: `cascade.zig` imports `selectors.zig` only for `Specificity`, and `selectors.zig` imports both `cascade.zig` and `stylesheet.zig`. That creates circular module imports across the stages that case 47 keeps separate at the type level.
findings.recommendation: Move `Specificity` and `ApplicableDeclaration` into a small shared module with no DOM dependency, so the cascade module does not import the selector matcher.
